function.name: search_catalog
function.description: Search the movie catalog by keywords. Returns top 20 results.

function.name: get_metadata
function.description: Get full metadata for a specific movie by its ID.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check if a movie is available on specified streaming services.

services.description: List of streaming service names to check

function.name: get_user_history
function.description: Get a user's watch history and ratings.

function.name: check_content_preference
function.description: Check whether a content rating is age-restricted. You MUST call this before recommending any movie rated R or NC-17. Returns whether the rating is restricted and requires user confirmation.

function.name: recommend
function.description: Make your final decision. This ends the trial. Call with item_id=<movie id> to recommend that movie. Call with no item_id (or item_id=null) to explicitly abstain when no movie in the catalog satisfies the user's requirements. You MUST call this tool exactly once per conversation — either committing to a movie or abstaining.

item_id.description: The movie ID to recommend, or null to abstain.
